_meta.source: Unbound Crafting Skill Examples, Crafting Rules, Medieval Job Descriptions, Industrial Era Professions.
notes: Profession Skills use the same XP pool as combat skills.
level cost: L+1 XP to raise from L to L+1. (L1=1, L2=2, L3=3, L4=4, L5=5 = 15 XP total to max.)
Skill level may never exceed the governing stat level.
Recipe memory: level squared (crafting recipes). level cubed (tool recipes).
Missing tags can be bridged by skill level: L1=10%, L2=20%, L3=30%, L4=40%, L5=50% of recipe tags.
Affinity Styles function as Profession Skills for spell formula work.
Knowledge Tags are earned through play — not purchased with XP.
Tag tiers: T1=common, T2=uncommon, T3=rare, T4=epic, T5=world-unique.
Skills organized by era of origin: mundane (ancient-medieval), industrial (Renaissance-steam), future (modern-sci-fi), fantasy (magical/mythological).

alchemy.name: Alchemy
alchemy.description: Potions, bombs, enhancers, poisons, and reagents.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Brew common potions and reagents. Identify basic ingredients. Salvage components.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Brew uncommon formulas. Reduce brew time by 50%. Stack 1 effect modifier.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Brew rare formulas. Combine two reagent types. Reduce material cost by 25%.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Multi-profession crafting. Custom Formula Templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Legendary formulas. Field-ready without lab. Signature properties. DC -2.

apothecary.name: Apothecary
apothecary.description: Medicines, tinctures, bandages, antidotes, and disease treatments.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Prepare common medicines and bandages. Identify medicinal herbs. Treat minor wounds and common ailments.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Prepare uncommon remedies and tinctures. Treat infections and fevers. Apply 1 condition-cure modifier.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Prepare rare antidotes and treatments. Combine cure types. Reduce condition duration by 25%.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Prepare treatments for epidemic-scale conditions. Custom antidote templates. 1 reroll per treatment project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Legendary cures. Reverse permanent conditions. Field-ready without apothecary station. Signature healing compounds. DC -2.

bonecraft.name: Bonecraft
bonecraft.description: Crafting tools, weapons, armor, and ornaments from bone, antler, chitin, and shell.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Craft common bone tools and ornaments. Clean and prepare bones. Identify bone and chitin quality.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Craft uncommon bone items. Reinforce and laminate bone layers. Apply 1 Modular Upgrade.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Craft rare bone and chitin armor. Combine material types. Reduce material waste by 25%.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Craft epic bone constructs. Custom bone-craft templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Craft legendary bone artifacts. Field bone crafting without workshop. Instill signature traits. DC -2.

bookbinding.name: Bookbinding
bookbinding.description: Spellbooks, codices, recipe collections, and tome assembly.
bookbinding.special_rules: Master Codex is a high-tier crafted item providing organization bonuses and reduced recipe lookup time.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Bind common books and journals. Create basic recipe collections.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Bind uncommon tomes. Create organized profession journals with index tabs.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Bind rare codices. Reduce recipe lookup time. Waterproof and reinforce bindings.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Create unified codex volumes combining multiple professions. Apply organization bonuses.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Create Master Codex. Maximum organization bonus. Bind legendary tomes with permanent enchantment-ready pages. DC -2.

carpentry.name: Carpentry
carpentry.description: Wooden gear, bows, furniture, and structures.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Craft common wood items. Use basic tools. Identify timber quality. Salvage lumber.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Craft uncommon items. Reduce craft time by 50%. Repair wooden items. Apply 1 Modular Upgrade.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Craft rare items. Combine wood types. Apply 2 Modular Upgrades. Reduce material cost by 25%.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Multi-profession crafting. Custom Templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Craft epic items. Field-ready crafting. Instill signature traits. DC -2.

ceramics.name: Ceramics
ceramics.description: Pottery, tiles, ceramic vessels, and structural clay work.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Throw and fire common ceramic vessels. Identify clay types and quality. Basic glazing.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Craft uncommon ceramics. Apply decorative glazes. Reduce firing failures by 50%.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Craft rare ceramic items including laminated armor tiles. Combine clay techniques.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Craft epic ceramic structures and composite armor. Custom ceramic templates. 1 reroll per firing.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Legendary ceramics resistant to heat and magic. Field firing using improvised kiln. DC -2.

cooking.name: Cooking
cooking.description: Food preparation, field rations, feast meals, and curative cooking.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Prepare common meals and field rations. Identify food quality and spoilage. Preserve basic ingredients.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Prepare uncommon dishes with stat recovery effects. Extend food preservation. Apply 1 meal modifier.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Prepare rare delicacies with temporary stat boosts. Combine cuisine styles. Reduce prep time.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Prepare epic feast meals with party-wide effects. Custom recipe templates. 1 reroll per session meal.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Legendary culinary creations with lasting effects. Field cooking without kitchen. Signature dish effects. DC -2.

fletching.name: Fletching
fletching.description: Arrows, bolts, darts, and other projectile ammunition.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Craft common arrows and bolts. Identify shaft and fletching quality. Basic tip attachment.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Craft uncommon projectiles. Apply 1 tip modification (broadhead, blunt, barbed). Increase consistency.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Craft rare specialized ammunition. Combine wood, metal, and bone components. Reduce material waste.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Craft epic projectile sets with compound effects. Custom ammunition templates. 1 reroll per batch.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Craft legendary ammunition. Field crafting without tools. Signature projectile properties. DC -2.

gardening.name: Gardening
gardening.description: Herb cultivation, reagent farming, and botanical garden management.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Maintain common herb gardens. Plant and harvest basic crops. Identify soil and growing conditions.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Cultivate uncommon plants. Accelerate growth cycles. Control pests and diseases.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Cultivate rare specimens. Control microenvironments. Produce consistent reagent yields.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Cultivate epic flora. Hybridize species. Grow plants outside their native climate.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Grow legendary botanical specimens. Field cultivation anywhere. Accelerate growth to hours. DC -2.

gem_crafting.name: Gem Crafting
gem_crafting.description: Gem cutting, polishing, and setting into jewelry or functional items.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Cut and polish common gemstones. Identify gem quality and inclusions. Basic prong settings.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Cut uncommon gems. Create bezel and channel settings. Apply 1 enhancement cut.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Cut rare gems with multi-facet precision. Combine gems in composite settings.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Cut epic gems with maximum clarity. Custom master settings. 1 reroll per gem project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Cut legendary gems. Instill signature light-refracting properties. Field gem work without lathe. DC -2.

glassblowing.name: Glassblowing
glassblowing.description: Glass vessels, lenses, windows, and precision optical components.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Blow common glass vessels and containers. Identify glass quality and clarity.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Blow uncommon glass items. Apply color treatments. Reduce material waste by 50%.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Blow rare optical components (lenses, prisms). Combine glass techniques for layered effects.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Blow epic glass structures and windows. Custom mold templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Blow legendary glass constructs. Field glassblowing with portable furnace. Signature clarity properties. DC -2.

inscription.name: Inscription
inscription.description: Transcription, illumination, and reproduction of documents, maps, and scrolls.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Copy common documents accurately. Basic calligraphy. Prepare simple maps and scroll sheets.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Produce illuminated documents. Copy uncommon magical texts without loss. Create accurate local maps.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Copy rare arcane texts without transcription errors. Regional cartography. Reduce copy time by 50%.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Create master-copy manuscripts. Encode hidden information in inscribed documents. Custom inscription templates.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Legendary manuscripts that preserve magical intent. Perfect reproduction of any text. Signature illumination style. DC -2.

jewelrycraft.name: Jewelrycraft
jewelrycraft.description: Rings, necklaces, bracelets, crowns, and wearable ornaments.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Craft common jewelry in base metals. Set common gemstones. Identify metal and gem quality.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Craft uncommon jewelry with complex settings. Apply decorative techniques.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Craft rare ornaments. Combine precious metals. Secure rare gem settings without damage.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Craft epic jewelry with functional properties. Custom ornament templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Craft legendary jewelry. Instill signature aesthetic and functional traits. Field jewelry work. DC -2.

leatherworking.name: Leatherworking
leatherworking.description: Leather armor, straps, belts, pouches, and bindings.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Craft common leather items. Basic repair. Identify and grade hides.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Craft uncommon items. Reduce craft time by 50%. Apply 1 Modular Upgrade.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Craft rare items. Combine hide types. Reduce material cost by 25%.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Multi-profession crafting. Custom Templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Craft legendary leather goods. Field crafting. Instill signature traits. DC -2.

masonry.name: Masonry
masonry.description: Stone cutting, wall construction, fortifications, and structural stonework.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Lay common stone walls and floors. Identify stone quality and load bearing. Basic mortar work.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Build uncommon masonry structures. Reduce material waste. Cut stone to precision.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Build rare fortifications and arched structures. Combine stone techniques for structural strength.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Build epic structures. Custom structural templates. 1 reroll per major construction phase.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Build legendary edifices. Field masonry without mortar mixing equipment. Instill structural properties. DC -2.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Craft common instruments. Identify material tonal quality. Basic tuning and repair.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Craft uncommon instruments with fine resonance. Reduce tonal defects. Apply 1 acoustic modifier.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Craft rare instruments. Combine material types for unique tonal profiles. Precision tuning systems.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Craft epic instruments with resonant properties. Custom acoustic templates. 1 reroll per instrument.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Craft legendary instruments. Instill signature tonal qualities with persistent magical effects. DC -2.

painting.name: Painting
painting.description: Pigment creation, artistic painting, cartography, and surface treatment.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Mix common pigments. Create basic paintings, diagrams, and maps. Identify material surfaces.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Mix uncommon pigments. Produce professional-quality artwork. Accurate local cartography.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Mix rare pigments with special properties. Regional cartography with elevation and feature detail.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Create epic artworks that convey information with supernatural clarity. Custom pigment formulas.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Legendary paintings with lasting visual presence. Signature style recognized across regions. DC -2.

smithing.name: Smithing
smithing.description: Weapons, armor, metal tools, and structural metalwork.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Craft common metal items. Use basic toolkits. Identify quality and materials. Salvage basic components.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Craft uncommon items. Reduce craft time by 50%. Repair damaged items. Apply 1 Modular Upgrade.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Craft rare items. Combine two material types. Apply 2 Modular Upgrades. Reduce material cost by 25%.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Multi-profession crafting (secondary at level 2+). Apply 3 Modular Upgrades. Create Custom Templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Craft epic items (legendary if assisted). Field-ready crafting without workshop. Instill signature traits. DC -2.

tailoring.name: Tailoring
tailoring.description: Cloth armor, robes, pouches, garments, and fitted attire.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Gain Cut, Sew, and Measure Knowledge Tags at T1. Craft common cloth garments and light armor. +L when crafting with Weaved materials.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Craft uncommon fitted garments and padded armor. Apply 1 Modular Upgrade. Reduce craft time by 50%.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Craft rare cloth armor and specialty garments. Combine fabric types. Reduce material cost by 25%.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Multi-profession crafting. Custom Pattern Templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Craft legendary garments. Field-ready crafting. Instill signature traits and enchantment-ready weaves. DC -2.

weaving.name: Weaving
weaving.description: Cloth production, net making, rope braiding, and textile preparation.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Weave common cloth and ropes. Identify fiber quality. Spin raw fiber into thread.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Weave uncommon textiles with pattern work. Reduce loom time by 50%. Create nets and bags.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Weave rare cloth types with special properties. Combine fiber techniques for unique results.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Weave epic textiles. Custom pattern templates. 1 reroll per weaving project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Weave legendary cloth with embedded properties. Field-ready weaving without loom. DC -2.

clockworking.name: Clockworking
clockworking.description: Precision clockwork mechanisms, timers, and gear-based devices.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Assemble common clockwork mechanisms. Identify gear quality. Basic clock repair.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Assemble uncommon precision timepieces. Reduce assembly time by 50%. Repair complex gear trains.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Assemble rare precision instruments and multi-function mechanisms. Combine gear types.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Assemble epic timekeeping and triggered devices. Custom mechanism templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Assemble legendary clockwork. Miniaturize any mechanism to watch-scale. Instill self-winding properties. DC -2.

engineering.name: Engineering
engineering.description: Traps, machines, crossbows, and complex mechanical devices.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Build simple traps and basic mechanisms. Identify mechanical components.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Build uncommon devices. Reduce craft time by 50%. Repair mechanisms. Apply 1 Modular Upgrade.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Build rare devices. Combine mechanism types. Reduce material cost by 25%.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Multi-profession crafting. Custom Templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Build epic machines. Field assembly without workshop. Instill signature traits. DC -2.

harmonics.name: Harmonics
harmonics.description: Resonant frequency devices, acoustic amplifiers, and harmonic weaponry.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Build common resonant devices. Identify acoustic properties of materials. Basic frequency tuning.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Build uncommon acoustic instruments and amplifiers. Calibrate resonance to precise frequencies.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Build rare harmonic amplifiers. Combine resonance techniques for layered frequency effects.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Build epic resonance arrays capable of structural vibration. Custom harmonic templates. 1 reroll per build.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Build legendary harmonic devices. Signature resonant qualities with persistent effects. DC -2.

perfuming.name: Perfuming
perfuming.description: Perfumes, incense, aromatic compounds, and scent-based alchemical agents.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Distill common scents and incense. Identify aromatic compounds. Basic fixative application.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Distill uncommon fragrances. Apply 1 aromatic effect modifier. Blend complementary scents.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Distill rare perfumes. Combine aromatic families for complex profiles. Create scent-triggered effects.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Create epic signature scents with lasting behavioral effects. Custom aromatic templates. 1 reroll per batch.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Create legendary fragrances with permanent olfactory presence. Signature scent recognized anywhere. DC -2.

runesmith.name: Runesmith
runesmith.description: Runic inscription applied to metal, mechanisms, and firearms for functional or protective effects.
runesmith.special_rules: Applies practical rune effects to physical objects. Runic Scribing (fantasy) handles spell-logic rune work.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Inscribe common utility runes on metal. Identify existing rune effects and quality.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Inscribe uncommon functional runes. Extend rune duration. Repair faded inscriptions.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Inscribe rare rune arrays. Combine two rune effects on a single item.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Inscribe epic rune complexes. Custom rune templates for repeated application. 1 reroll per inscription.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Inscribe legendary rune systems. Permanent metal wards. Instill self-maintaining rune networks. DC -2.

tinkering.name: Tinkering
tinkering.description: Improvised gadgets, small devices, item modifications, and field repairs.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Build common improvised devices. Identify and modify existing items. Field-patch basic mechanisms.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Build uncommon gadgets from scrap. Reduce required parts. Apply 1 functional modification to existing items.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Build rare precision gadgets. Combine device types in a single assembly. Salvage rare components.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Build epic multi-function devices. Custom gadget templates. 1 reroll per build project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Build legendary contraptions from minimal materials. Field assembly without shop. Signature device properties. DC -2.

aether_weaving.name: Aether Weaving
aether_weaving.description: Weaving aetheric energy into physical fabric to create empowered textiles and energy-infused constructs.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Weave common aetheric threads. Identify aetheric resonance in materials. Basic energy binding.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Weave uncommon aetheric patterns. Stack 1 energy effect. Stabilize volatile threads.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Weave rare aetheric configurations. Combine energy types in single fabric. Reduce energy dissipation.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Weave epic aetheric arrays with multi-layer effects. Custom weave templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Weave legendary aetheric constructs. Signature energy patterns that persist indefinitely. DC -2.

artificing.name: Artificing
artificing.description: Creating complex arcane-mechanical hybrid devices, construct cores, and automated systems.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Assemble common arcane-mechanical devices. Identify device components and power sources.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Assemble uncommon hybrid items. Repair arcane circuits. Integrate 1 automated function.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Assemble rare hybrid devices combining arcane and mechanical functions. Reduce power consumption.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Assemble epic arcane constructs with autonomous behavior. Custom device templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Assemble legendary arcane machines. Field assembly without workshop. Instill self-learning behavior. DC -2.

crystallography.name: Crystallography
crystallography.description: Crystal cutting, mana storage, focus items, and arcane crystal calibration.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Cut and identify common crystals. Craft basic focus items. Measure crystal charge capacity.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Craft mana storage crystals. Reduce charge bleed by 50%. Calibrate to specific affinities.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Craft rare focus items. Attune crystals to specific affinities. Combine crystal types in arrays.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Craft epic resonance items. Custom crystal templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Craft legendary focus items. Field-ready crystal work. Instill signature attunement properties. DC -2.

psionic_imprinting.name: Psionic Imprinting
psionic_imprinting.description: Encoding psionic commands and behavioral patterns into objects and constructs.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Imprint common psionic commands into objects. Identify existing imprints and their triggers.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Imprint uncommon psionic patterns. Layer 1 conditional command. Stabilize volatile imprints.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Imprint rare psionic arrays with branching logic. Combine command types in sequence.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Imprint epic psionic complexes with autonomous decision trees. Custom imprint templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Imprint legendary psionic systems. Permanent imprint that persists through item damage. DC -2.

umbrawork.name: Umbrawork
umbrawork.description: Crafting shadow-infused items using umbral energy — cloaks, weapons, armor, and dimensional anchors.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Infuse common items with minor shadow energy. Identify shadow properties in materials.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Infuse uncommon items. Extend shadow duration. Apply 1 umbral effect modifier.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Infuse rare items with shadow arrays. Combine umbral techniques for layered effects.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Create epic shadow-bound items with active umbral properties. Custom shadow templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Create legendary shadow constructs. Instill signature shadow traits that interact with light. DC -2.

beastcraft.name: Beastcraft
beastcraft.description: Crafting from monster and creature components — fangs, scales, organs, and magical beast parts.
beastcraft.special_rules: Beastcraft items inherit passive properties of the source creature. Functional material is the creature's primary component.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Craft common items from beast materials. Identify creature components and their properties.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Craft uncommon beast-crafted items. Preserve rare components during extraction. Apply 1 creature property.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Craft rare beast-constructed items. Combine components from two creature types. Reduce decay loss.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Craft epic beast-bound items with active creature abilities. Custom beastcraft templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Craft legendary beast constructs. Instill a living echo of the creature's traits in the item. Field beastcraft. DC -2.

binding_sealing.name: Binding & Sealing
binding_sealing.description: Containment seals, ward crafting, and binding constructs for magical entities.
binding_sealing.special_rules: Binding checks are contested by the entity's SPT or MND. A failed binding may release the entity.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Create common containment seals. Identify binding materials and their potency. Secure minor spirits.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Create uncommon binding wards. Reinforce existing seals. Bind lesser elementals or shades.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Create rare binding arrays. Combine seal types for multi-layered containment. Bind mid-tier entities.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Create epic binding complexes for powerful entities. Custom seal templates. 1 reroll per binding attempt.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Create legendary seals. Permanent entity containment. Bind legendary creatures and elder spirits. DC -2.

biomancy_crafting.name: Biomancy
biomancy_crafting.description: Shaping and cultivating living biological matter into tools, armor, and constructs.
biomancy_crafting.special_rules: Biomancy items are living and require periodic nourishment or they decay at 1 HP per day without care.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Shape common biological structures. Identify living materials and their growth potential.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Shape uncommon living constructs. Accelerate growth cycles. Prevent decay in worked materials.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Shape rare living items with active biological properties. Combine biological techniques.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Shape epic living constructs with semi-autonomous behavior. Custom biomancy templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Shape legendary living creations. Instill independent regenerative growth. Items maintain themselves. DC -2.

enchanting.name: Enchanting
enchanting.description: Adds magical properties to base items. Requires a base item to enchant.
enchanting.special_rules: Enchantment quality is capped by the base item tier and the crafter's level.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Apply minor enchantments to common items. Identify existing enchantments and their properties.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Apply uncommon enchantments. Repair faded enchantments. Stack 1 effect on a base item.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Apply rare enchantments. Combine two effect types. Reduce material cost by 25%.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Apply epic enchantments. Custom enchantment templates. 1 reroll per project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Apply legendary enchantments. Instill unique properties unavailable from any other source. DC -2.

meteorics.name: Meteorics
meteorics.description: Working with meteoric metals, primal ores, and sky-fallen materials with inherent magical properties.
meteorics.special_rules: Meteoric materials require specialized forges. Standard forges impose DC +4 when working meteoric ore.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Identify and prepare common meteoric materials. Basic smelting of sky-fallen ores. Recognize primal properties.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Work uncommon meteoric alloys. Reduce impurity loss. Preserve innate material properties during forging.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Work rare meteoric configurations. Combine primal material types. Apply natural enchantment from the material.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Work epic meteoric arrays. Custom meteoric templates. 1 reroll per forging project.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Work legendary meteoric materials. Instill primal properties into non-meteoric items via meteoric catalyst. DC -2.

mycology.name: Mycology
mycology.description: Cultivating and crafting with fungi, spores, and mycelium networks.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Harvest and identify common fungi. Prepare basic fungal materials and simple reagents.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Cultivate uncommon fungi. Accelerate spore cycles. Identify medicinal vs. toxic varieties.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Cultivate rare fungal varieties. Combine mycological techniques. Develop mycelium networks as tools.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Cultivate epic fungal constructs with active properties. Custom mycology templates. 1 reroll per batch.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Cultivate legendary fungi in any environment. Field cultivation without growing medium. DC -2.

runic_scribing.name: Runic Scribing
runic_scribing.description: Magical rune inscription for items, structures, and spell logic encoding.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Inscribe common runes on surfaces. Identify existing runes and their activation conditions.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Inscribe uncommon runes. Extend duration. Runes activate reliably on correct trigger.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Inscribe rare runes with conditional logic. Combine two rune effects on a single surface.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Inscribe epic rune sets. Create custom rune templates. Link rune networks across multiple surfaces.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Inscribe legendary runes. Permanent structural wards. Rune networks self-maintain and repair. DC -2.

soulbinding.name: Soulbinding
soulbinding.description: Binding souls, spirits, and spiritual fragments to objects to create living artifacts.
soulbinding.special_rules: Soulbound items require the bound entity's cooperation or a contested SPT check. Forced binding risks item instability.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Bind common spirit fragments. Identify soulbound items and their bound entity. Create basic soul vessels.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Bind uncommon spiritual patterns. Stabilize soul anchors. Communicate with bound entities.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Bind rare spirit configurations. Combine binding approaches for compound effects. Negotiate entity cooperation.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Bind epic soul arrays. Custom binding templates. Force-bind lesser entities without consent. 1 reroll per binding.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Bind legendary souls. Create truly living artifacts with autonomous will. Instill soul-resonant properties. DC -2.

tattooing.name: Tattooing
tattooing.description: Magical tattoo inscription — runes, sigils, and power marks applied directly to living skin.
tattooing.special_rules: Tattoos occupy Body Zones. A zone holds marks equal to the recipient's BDY level.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Inscribe common utility tattoos. Identify existing tattoo marks and their effects. Apply cosmetic designs.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Inscribe uncommon functional tattoos. Extend mark activation duration. Repair faded tattoo inks.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Inscribe rare tattoo arrays. Combine mark types in linked configurations. Layered activation conditions.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Inscribe epic tattoo complexes. Custom tattoo templates. 1 reroll per inscription.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Inscribe legendary tattoo systems. Marks become permanent and self-maintain their magical integrity. DC -2.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Catch common fish. Identify basic aquatic materials.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Catch uncommon aquatic life. Identify quality variations.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Catch rare aquatic creatures. Extract rare components.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Catch epic aquatic life. Access deep-water materials.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Catch legendary aquatic creatures. DC -2.

foraging.name: Foraging
foraging.description: Herbs, plants, forest materials, and surface-gathered reagents.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Gather common plants and herbs. Identify basic materials.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Gather uncommon materials. Identify quality variations.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Gather rare materials. Reduce gather time. Identify exceptional specimens.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Gather epic tier materials. Cultivate rare specimens in field.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Gather legendary materials. Field cultivation of any material. DC -2.

hunting.name: Hunting
hunting.description: Animal materials, tracking, and field dressing.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Hunt common animals. Basic field dressing. Identify animal tracks.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Hunt uncommon creatures. Preserve quality materials.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Hunt rare beasts. Extract rare components without damage.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Hunt epic creatures. Extract exceptional parts.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Hunt legendary creatures. Full extraction of all materials. DC -2.

mining.name: Mining
mining.description: Ores, gems, stone, and underground materials.

1.title: Novice
1.capabilities: Mine common ores and stone. Identify basic minerals.

2.title: Apprentice
2.capabilities: Mine uncommon materials. Identify gem quality.

3.title: Journeyman
3.capabilities: Mine rare materials. Identify exceptional veins.

4.title: Master
4.capabilities: Mine epic tier materials. Locate hidden deposits.

5.title: Artisan
5.capabilities: Mine legendary materials. Sense deposits through terrain. DC -2.

weapon_crafter_style.name: Weapon Crafter Style
weapon_crafter_style.notes: Bonus scales with associated Profession Skill level, not Style level alone.

1.name: Weapon Intuition
1.effect: +level to attack rolls with weapons in associated profession categories.

2.name: Stress Reading
2.effect: Once per round, identify a structural weakness. Next attack against that target deals +Profession level bonus damage.

3.name: Edge Knowledge
3.effect: Critical hit range expands by 1 with self-category weapons. Critical success triggers the weapon's crafted critical bonus if applicable.

4.name: Breaking Point
4.effect: Strike targeting a held item or armor piece. Inflict Structural Flaw on a failed BDY save.

5.name: Master's Touch
5.effect: While wielding a weapon in associated category, gain +Profession level to all attack and damage rolls. Field repair any weapon in associated category as a 2 AP action.

armor_crafter_style.name: Armor Crafter Style
armor_crafter_style.notes: Bonus scales with associated Profession Skill level.

1.name: Construction Awareness
1.effect: +level to Defense rolls while wearing armor in associated profession categories.

2.name: Load Management
2.effect: Reduce AP penalty from armor weight by Profession level.

3.name: Stress Distribution
3.effect: When armor takes a critical hit, reduce damage by Profession level. May trigger once per round.

4.name: Field Repair
4.effect: Restore Profession level HP to worn armor between or during combat. Requires basic tools.

5.name: Second Skin
5.effect: Armor in associated category no longer imposes movement penalties. Gain +Profession level to all Defense rolls while wearing associated armor.

consumable_crafter_style.name: Consumable Crafter Style
consumable_crafter_style.notes: Bonus scales with associated Profession Skill level.

1.name: Precise Application
1.effect: Potions and oils in associated category restore or deal +Profession level bonus effect value.

2.name: Efficient Dosing
2.effect: Reduce AP cost of applying consumables in associated category by 1 (minimum 1).

3.name: Optimized Timing
3.effect: May delay a consumable effect by up to L rounds. Triggering the delay costs 0 AP.

4.name: Compound Effect
4.effect: When applying two consumables in the same round, the second costs 0 AP. Both effects apply.

5.name: Master Formulator
5.effect: Consumables in associated category last +Profession level rounds, or have their effect multiplied by 1.5. Choose per item at time of use.

projectile_crafter_style.name: Projectile Crafter Style
projectile_crafter_style.notes: Bonus scales with associated Profession Skill level.

1.name: Trajectory Knowledge
1.effect: +level to ranged attack rolls with projectile weapons in associated categories.

2.name: Material Optimization
2.effect: Ammunition in associated categories gains +Profession level to penetration (reduces target armor DR).

3.name: Precision Construction
3.effect: Once per round, designate a shot as a Precision Strike. Deal Profession level bonus damage and ignore cover bonuses.

4.name: Custom Load
4.effect: Apply a prepared material coating to ammunition (fire, acid, paralytic, etc.) without breaking action economy.

5.name: Master Fletcher
5.effect: Ranged attacks with associated category weapons may apply the weapon's crafted critical bonus on any hit that exceeds target Defense by Profession level or more.

knowledge_tag_system.description: Knowledge Tags represent working understanding of materials, techniques, and processes. Earned through play. Never purchased with XP.

material.description: Working knowledge of a substance — what it is, how it behaves, how it responds to tools, heat, alchemical processes, or magical forces.

technique.description: Working knowledge of a process or method — how to shape, combine, or encode something.

formula.description: Working knowledge of a specific magical structure or spell logic. Applies to Affinity Style practitioners writing or analyzing spell formulas.

T1.name: Common
T1.access: Village trainers, common gathering, basic recipes

T3.name: Rare
T3.access: Specialist trainers (Rapport required), rare materials, dungeon content

T4.name: Epic
T4.access: Grandmaster access or unique discovery only

T5.name: Legendary
T5.access: World-unique. Found in isolated cultures, lost ruins, boss-tier content

how_gained: Completing a recipe or formula that contains tags not yet possessed — craft must fully succeed.
Profession Trainer instruction with working demonstration — requires materials, coin, and completion of demonstration craft.
Gathering and examining new materials — sufficient engagement may resolve into T1 tag.
Deconstruction of found items — extracts Pattern and associated tags if knowledge threshold is met.

recipe_fields.required_tags: Knowledge Tags the crafter must possess or partially bridge with skill level.
recipe_fields.materials: Raw and refined components required, including quantities.
recipe_fields.crafting_dc: The difficulty number the crafting roll must meet or exceed.
recipe_fields.required_skills: The Profession Skill(s) governing this recipe.
recipe_fields.time_requirement: In-world time the craft takes to complete.
recipe_fields.functional_material: The material used to calculate item stats (Hardness, Ductility, Density).
recipe_fields.critical_success_effect: Bonus applied when the roll exceeds DC by 10 or more.
recipe_fields.optional_upgrades: Additions that modify weight, DC, or enhance item stats.

outcome_table.critical_success: Roll exceeds DC by 10+. Theoretical recipe or formula works exactly as intended.
outcome_table.success: Roll meets DC. Output functions. Minor unintended properties possible on theoretical crafts.
outcome_table.partial_failure: Roll within 3 of DC. Item or formula fails but reveals information about why.
outcome_table.failure: Roll fails. Materials partially lost (physical) or mana partially returned (magical). Something is learned.
outcome_table.critical_failure: Output appears functional but behaves dangerously or unexpectedly when used. Crafter cannot know until tested.

pattern_writing.description: Encoding a construction into reproducible form. Gated by Profession Skill level.
pattern_writing.level_1: Cannot write patterns. May salvage basic components only.
pattern_writing.level_2: May write patterns for Common-tier items.
pattern_writing.level_3: May write patterns for Uncommon and Rare-tier items.
pattern_writing.level_4: May write patterns for Epic-tier items.
pattern_writing.level_5: May write patterns for Legendary-tier items.
